out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed sign that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the middle prep line handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. CDI: CFM placed hand washing sign at the hand sink located in the middle of the prep line.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock (raw mussels and oysters) has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification. EHS observed raw mussels and oysters relocated to the front Beverage Air 2 Dr refrigerator, from the original shellstock containers stored in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. CDI: CFM made a photo copy of the original shellstock tags for the raw mussels and oysters and stored with the containers of raw mussels and oysters stored out of the original containers.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored directly above several 5lb gallon buckets of housemade quick kimchi inside the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated the raw shelled eggs to the bottom shelf inside the walk in refrigerator.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: raw oysters/ mussels, undercooked steak tartare, and Hwe Moo- chim (salmon sashimi) is missing reminder (asterisk) next to items on the happy hour menu page. The reminder (asterisk) is present on the other pages of the menu for raw oysters/ mussels, undercooked steak tartare, and Hwe Moo- chim (salmon sashimi).
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions. CDI: CFM updated happy hour menu to include the reminder (asterisk) next to the raw oysters/ mussels, undercooked steak tartare, and Hwe Moo- chim (salmon sashimi) during the inspection. .

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed ice bin that has been cleaned not stored covered or inverted in back of kitchen near the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized the ice bin and stored inverted on clean contact surface.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: Observed the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label for fresh/raw mussels and oysters.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. CDI: EHS trained CFM to record the date the last shellstock from the container was sold or served on the tag or label for fresh/raw mussels and oysters. Ingle Korean Steakhouse (Inspection Date: 12/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: Observed the food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS sent CFM written procedures to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events via email Ingle Korean Steakhouse (Inspection Date: 07/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quat sanitizer solution (buckets) was measured at 400 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of @SANITIZER@ solution at @##@ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI: CFM added additional water to quat solution. CFM stated they follow the manufacturer instructions. EHS advised CFM to test solution prior to using to ensure it falls between the ranges of 200ppm- 300ppm

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: In-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Pitcher handle used as scoop directly touching rice in bulk container.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM removed pitcher from rice bulk bin container.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: In-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Observed ladle stored in standing water (77F) on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM removed ladle from water and placed in dry container. The CFM uses the water in container for cooking.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins are not being cleaned as required. Black buildup observed.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The ambient (air/water) temperature measuring device located in the 5 door prep refrigerator unit is not accurate in degrees F, the digital display shows 47F. Holding temp is 41F.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/-3 degrees F in the intended range of use. PIC will add a thermometer to the unit until the digital probe is calibrated.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor of the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS recommended purchasing additional storage racks or decreasing delivery load.
